primary_source.name: WIDER FACE v1.0
primary_source.expected_labels: Per-image face bounding boxes in wider_face_train_bbx_gt.txt and wider_face_val_bbx_gt.txt; test boxes are not publicly released.
primary_source.published_scope: 32,203 full-scene images and 393,703 labeled faces; event-stratified 40% train, 10% validation, 50% test.
primary_source.use: Use train images/boxes for detector training and validation images/boxes for development/calibration under a frozen group policy. Do not claim labeled test evaluation without annotations.
primary_source.negative_scene_limit: The official source says images without human faces were filtered during collection. WIDER FACE therefore does not supply genuine no-face scenes.

separate_negative_scene_dependency.name: verified empty target-camera scenes
separate_negative_scene_dependency.requirement: Capture and visually verify full-frame no-face scenes using the target optical path. Keep capture session/lighting/location metadata and split by capture session; do not synthesize these negatives from face crops.
separate_negative_scene_dependency.minimum_staging_plan: At least 200 frames across four lighting states and five view locations, with two separately recorded sessions; use one session for training and hold the other for development. Expand only after checking scene variety.

download_verification.archive_crc_checks: pass for all three ZIP files
download_verification.reason: Raw train/validation and annotation archives were downloaded from the official page-linked, commit-pinned CUHK-CSE mirror and their published SHA-256 values and ZIP CRCs pass. Preparation stopped before an image manifest was generated because annotation parsing encountered a zero-box record followed by a placeholder row. No per-image decode, full annotation count, or detector dataset receipt was completed.

source_rights_note: The WIDER FACE project page identifies the dataset as CC BY-NC-ND. Check the current source terms before redistribution or derivative publication.
acceptance: C preparation remains with its assigned owner: finish parsing/indexing the staged train/validation images and boxes, then capture session-separated target-camera empty scenes. No detector training/readiness claim is made.
